title: Local sessions get every allow, autoMode entry and setting that cloud sessions get, on Mac and Windows
why: The owner is never at the local keyboard, so local sessions that stop to ask are worse than cloud ones that do not. Lane limits for the runner 04:21 CST Nov 14 (via the coordinator 04:21, the lane's words, unchecked by triage): desktop and start_session sessions get no role file; the 3 merge allows are not in PR #3389 and become local-ready once it lands: move the rules from merge/cloud_allow.json to settings.json permissions.allow, drop the cloud-only jq merge in install.sh, check the Windows merge.cmd rule form, and leave the `merge --role` rule cloud-only. Act 3 on the owner's Mac and PC waits for this PR on main. Debt self-role-claim-false-alarms is open. The lane's refuter proposed a simpler route (read CS_SESSION_ROLE from the environment, no role file); the lane says it departs from an owner pick b. Triage has no record of that pick: the coordinator is asked which item and time. The route goes to the owner as a question, not decided by the lane or the coordinator. CORRECTION 04:24 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 04:23, from the #3389 lane, relayed; triage did not read the item): the "owner pick b" my earlier line cites was wrong. Its source is page item 213 (local-triage-tier-word, closed): `pick` "b" was the coordinator's recommendation, not the owner's; his answer (lastAnswer 2026-11-05 07:44 CST) was "none": "it'd have to be working on mac or windows if file version. else build nothing for now on this is ok too put this as a debt" (filed as step mac-triage-tier-debt). So the refuter's env-variable route (CS_SESSION_ROLE, no file) departs from no owner pick and goes to the owner as no question; it is a design choice for the lane, bounded by his words: it must work on Mac and Windows. The lane corrected its PR body. My earlier line "goes to the owner as a question" is withdrawn.
